build_model: build a new differentiable rendering model instance with reader, encoder, field, and raymarcher components
forward_pass: run a forward pass through the model to render rays and compute colors and depths
visualize_output: visualize rendered colors, depths, and normals from model output and sample data
add_eval_scores: compute SSIM, PSNR, LPIPS, and RMSE evaluation scores comparing predicted and target images
add_args: register command-line arguments for hierarchical sampling and fine model optimization to an argparse parser
